purpose: Own one canonical cognition contract: keep framing provisional, adapt search depth to evidence and risk, falsify competing frames, admit root scope and learning disposition before action, and verify the smallest justified change.

stage_semantics.FRAME_AS_HYPOTHESIS: User wording, the Agent's first interpretation, external authorities, existing code and the first plausible repair are provisional frames, not root-cause authority.
stage_semantics.EXPAND_PROBLEM_SPACE_WHEN_NEEDED: Use adaptive bounded search. Small one-off local defects may remain compact; corrections/change proposals compare alternatives; repeated/systemic/material/high-risk or unknown cases use structured multi-hypothesis and multi-action search. Broad external capability learning models the source itself and uses multiple outside-in lenses rather than known-keyword search only.
stage_semantics.FALSIFY_COMPETING_FRAMES: Seek evidence that would make the preferred frame wrong. Same-model self-questioning is candidate-search evidence, not independent verification. Material/systemic cases preserve at least one rejected alternative and test upstream/architecture involvement.
stage_semantics.COMMIT_ROOT_SCOPE_AND_LEARNING_DISPOSITI: Only after evidence selects/bounds the problem layer may the system choose root scope, evolution disposition and durable-record requirement.
stage_semantics.ACT_AND_VERIFY: Execute the smallest authorized repair/redesign/no-change/block consistent with admitted scope and verify against the governing objective.

cognition_kernel.anti_bloat: The five stages are the hot-path cognitive primitives. Other policies may activate them or constrain ownership/assurance, but must not duplicate a separate cognition state machine.

LIGHTWEIGHT.minimum: one evidence-tested hypothesis; compact diagnosis and verification

CONTRASTIVE.minimum: at least two competing hypotheses and two action candidates with explicit tradeoff evidence

STRUCTURED.minimum: at least two hypotheses, at least three action candidates, explicit NO_CHANGE baseline, falsification, and upstream/architecture reassessment when systemic

cognitive_search_modes.self_dialogue_boundary: DIVERGE_ATTACK_CONVERGE is an internal candidate-search method inside EXPAND/FALSIFY, not a second controller or proof of independence. Independent verification must come from owner evidence, deterministic tests, external tools/sources, a separate execution path/model when warranted, or human approval where required.

principles: Lightweight problem detection is always-on for every assistant turn after authority selection; adaptive deliberation is not a permanent heavy debate loop.
The mutation sentinel is separately always-on before external or durable mutation attempts.

Research depth follows uncertainty and risk. A one-off local defect does not require ceremonial web research when current evidence is sufficient; repeated/systemic/material/high-risk/unknown or knowledge-gap cases do require external research.

Move micro -> macro -> micro inside the canonical cognition kernel: reproduce the symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology, generate enough competing hypotheses for the selected search mode, falsify alternatives, admit root scope, then return to the smallest justified change.
The first plausible cause or first available repair is not root-cause evidence.
User corrections, user theories and external methods/Skills are evidence inputs, not automatic root-cause authority.
Repeated/cross-subsystem/architecture-gap/complexity-growth/scope-expansion signals require explicit architecture/upstream hypothesis testing before action.
Research must affect diagnosis or repair choice; ceremonial browsing does not satisfy admission.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
Counterexample search and independent verification add depth according to risk.
Material architecture fitness includes lived scenario operability and competing-candidate tradeoff evidence, not structural description alone.

Stop deliberating when root scope is evidence-admitted for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or bounded, the bounded search contract is satisfied, and the selected action demonstrably advances the governing objective without unnecessary complexity.

always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.responsibility: Before declaring deliberation NOT_TRIGGERED, classify current user/evidence signals for defects, degradation, correction, contradiction, uncertainty, knowledge gaps, architecture/control-plane gaps or other unreliable-goal signals.
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: Always-on means always-on detection, not permanent heavy research or debate when no problem is detected.

outside_in_capability_discovery.source_first_rule: Before querying for specific Skills, model how the source itself organizes knowledge and what discovery axes it exposes.
outside_in_capability_discovery.broad_discovery_floor: Use at least two distinct outside-in lenses and produce evidence-grounded latent capability-gap candidates. A known-need/keyword-only survey is not broad discovery.
outside_in_capability_discovery.nonliteral_rule: A role, occupation, taxonomy or creator portfolio is a discovery lens, not an instruction to create a matching Agent, architecture layer or organization chart.
outside_in_capability_discovery.known_need_exception: A narrow lookup for an already established need/failure class may remain lightweight and does not require the broad discovery floor.

root_scope_admission.purpose: Prevent premature repair by requiring the selected problem layer/root hypothesis and the risk-appropriate candidate search to be evidence-tested before repair/no-change.
root_scope_admission.baseline_rule: Every repair/no-change requires one selected evidence-tested root hypothesis; a repair path is not a substitute for root-scope evidence.
systemic_requirements: compare at least two hypotheses across at least two problem layers
include at least one architecture/upstream hypothesis
preserve evidence for at least one rejected alternative
preserve architecture reassessment evidence even when the final selected root cause is local
compare at least three action candidates including an explicit NO_CHANGE baseline
root_scope_admission.anti_anchoring: A user statement, external authority, popular Skill, existing implementation or first plausible theory may seed a hypothesis but cannot be directly promoted to selected root cause without test/falsification evidence.

external_architecture_scout.authority_rule: External sources inform hypotheses and candidate mechanisms; they do not become UAOS authority by reputation, popularity or publication alone.

before_mutation: pass the mutation sentinel for the proposed side-effect path
enter the canonical cognition kernel from observed evidence rather than the preferred solution
satisfy all required deliberation evidence dimensions and bounded search requirements
pass root-scope admission; for systemic triggers explicitly test architecture/upstream alternatives
record an evolution/learning disposition and durable causal evidence when material/evolution-relevant
for material architecture changes apply config/ARCHITECTURE_EXPERIENCE_POLICY.json and current-agent dogfood
when counterexample_search_required is true test a plausible alternative/failure counterexample
do not call same-model critique independent verification
closure_guard: scan all current top-level authorities that can encode the changed semantic
scan host control surfaces when the assurance claim depends on them
for architecture changes confirm structural contracts and scenario/walkthrough behavior agree
resolve or explicitly bound every contradiction before reporting RESOLVED
run reproducible evaluation on the final candidate tree and post-promotion observation on production authority

anti_bloat: Keep one canonical cognition state machine in this policy; activation/assurance policies reference it instead of copying it.
Use bounded search modes rather than permanent multi-Agent debate or unbounded self-dialogue.
Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem.
Do not add a second controller or parallel problem journal to enforce this transaction.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Prefer executable admission/fitness properties over accumulating guarantee prose.
Do not require a stronger assurance tier merely because it is available.
